_comment: Final-cell pixel coordinates (256 cell, facing right), measured by Claude 2026-10-11 on the title-style art (packed frames, --quantize 48). Hit boxes cover the striking limb's contact end; light2 and specialForward f2 keep their auto boxes (already on the palm / the flicking hand). heavy v05 strikes with the R elbow folded across the face (no palm lift is drawn in f4); airHeavy uses the clasped hands. `_v` = the strip version a block was measured on: re-measure when it changes. `_scale` = the strip's auto head fit at that version. No gameplay damage or reach tuning.
_hands: hand: palm/fingertip point (256 cell) for shots and beams; measured by Claude 2026-10-11 on the title-style art. throw f1 and specialForward f2: the R flick fingertips (Reversal: Red spawn); beamFire: the thrust palm (beam origin). beamCharge palms (no anchor: kit.js places Hollow Purple's Red and Blue at fixed offsets): far/Blue (192, 96) on f0/f2 and (172, 96) on f1, near/Red (68, 96) on f0/f2 and (78, 95) on f1.

light3._refit: scaled x0.9479 about the pivot with the strip's bodyHeight 228 -> 216 (size consistency pass, 2026-10-11)

heavy._note: heavy v05 strikes with the R elbow folded across the chin (x 132-153, 0.17-0.20 units forward): a box on it can never reach past the 0.72 minimum spacing, so the launcher would always whiff. The old box in front of the face is kept until the heavy is redrawn or Gojo's heavy lunge is tuned (QA-TITLE-CONTACT, 2026-10-11).
